checks.name: frontend
checks.full: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build

rules.haiku: Small, well-specified, low-risk changes: boilerplate, renames, simple DTOs or entities, config tweaks, docs, straightforward tests. Never for auth, permissions, remote host access or the audit log.
rules.sonnet: Everything else: multi-file features, non-trivial logic, debugging, refactors, concurrency and streaming, and anything touching auth, permissions, remote host access or the audit log. When unsure, use sonnet.

lenses.name: security
lenses.when: the diff touches auth, permissions, remote host access, the audit log, subprocess execution, path handling, secrets or tokens
lenses.checklist: authorization on every new entry point; input validation and injection (SQL, command, path traversal, prompt); secrets in code, logs or tests; token and crypto handling; malicious-case tests exist for the security-relevant code (see next-task-write-tests)

lenses.name: ui
lenses.checklist: follows the apple-design skill (read .claude/skills/apple-design/SKILL.md): design tokens instead of literal values, spacing and typography, loading, empty, error and disabled states, both themes, accessibility (roles, labels, focus order, contrast)

lenses.name: ux
lenses.checklist: the user flows the work set adds work end to end across its beads: each new screen or action is reachable, navigation and wording are consistent, error and empty paths lead somewhere, no dead ends, and the e2e specs cover the main journey
